basis: Values copied unchanged from rtx3070-profiles.json (same source snapshot, same Ampere family, 32-lane waves). Not retuned for 12 GB: no matched AstraForge runs exist on the RTX 3060. Change a value only with matched captures per docs/benchmark-procedure.md.

Stability.intent: Leave more DXGI budget headroom for render targets and other allocations; may increase texture waits or missing textures.

Balanced.intent: Source default for texture-copy admission; closest to the measured Series S baseline.

Performance.intent: Reduce texture-copy residency versus the default to limit paging risk; performance benefit is unverified on the RTX 3060.

Quality.intent: Allow more texture copies to reside on the GPU; consumes more of the local budget. The 12 GB card may tolerate this better than 8 GB, but that is unmeasured.
